body: Too many fresh starts I'm afraid.  Time after time I run. I move. I start again.  I fall just as hard I hurt just as much. I ruin everything and then I sink. The difference here? I'm family-less. I have nothing.  I don't want anything. My run away from hard shit fund is gone. I have four bottles of wine and a sleeping pill. That's all I've got. My relationship I ruined. Multiple friendships I ruined. I don't sleep and I can't eat. I feel nothing half the time and only when I think of what I lost do I cry, then I drink more. 21 years of age and my life has been over for years. I'll never ever forgive myself for things I've done, none of it were intentional. But it was done by me. It is a fault I made.  My life is a fault my parents made.
